title: What lives in the deep sea?
note: Little Big Questions, deep sea (6 to 8), a silent story: Fable Cutaway lifted slice, a tall column of ocean over its hole in a sunny sea, one fixed view, a 2 degree sway, no cuts. A little round submarine descends through the sunlight, twilight and midnight zones to a hot vent. Timing from beats.json through the one event table at the top of blender.py. Music: Mendelssohn, The Hebrides Overture (Musopen Symphony, public domain), edit in beats.json; soundtrack in audio/mix.m4a (audio/make_audio.py, SOUND.md).
